audit.why: Equinox is 20s at rank 1, falling to 16s — it silences before rooting, so a player who pre-casts an escape into it wastes it; better to wait the silence out. Soraka's W and R both heal off chip damage, so anti-heal timing changes how much lane poke actually converts.
